source.attacking_direction: Away attacks toward x=0 in period 1
source.goalkeeper_rule: Home player with median x closest to the defended x=0 goal during the sequence.

definitions.centroid: Arithmetic mean x/y position of Home outfield players with valid coordinates.
definitions.width: Maximum minus minimum Home outfield y coordinate.
definitions.length: Maximum minus minimum Home outfield x coordinate.
definitions.centroid_to_ball: Euclidean distance between the Home outfield centroid and tracked ball.
definitions.missing_coordinates: A missing player is excluded only for that frame; frames with a missing ball are excluded.
